# Supercell
> Supercell is a mobile game company publishing and supporting globally popular games, player support resources, and careers information.

Supercell.com provides information about Supercell’s games, company, player safety policies, support resources, legal documents, media assets, and global careers.

## Games
- [Games](https://supercell.com/en/games/): Overview of Supercell’s game portfolio and official game destinations.
- [Brawl Stars](https://supercell.com/en/games/brawlstars/): Official page for Brawl Stars with game information and related resources.
- [Clash Royale](https://supercell.com/en/games/clashroyale/): Official page for Clash Royale with game details and updates.
- [Boom Beach](https://supercell.com/en/games/boombeach/): Official page for Boom Beach and related game information.
- [Clash of Clans](https://supercell.com/en/games/clashofclans/): Official page for Clash of Clans and core game resources.
- [Hay Day](https://supercell.com/en/games/hayday/): Official page for Hay Day with game overview and links.
- [Squad Busters](https://squadbusters.supercell.com/en/): Official standalone site for Squad Busters.
- [mo.co](https://mo.co): Official standalone site for mo.co.

## Careers
- [Careers](https://supercell.com/en/careers/): Main careers hub for working at Supercell.
- [Open Positions](https://supercell.com/en/careers/#join): Current job openings and application entry point.
- [Why You Might Love It Here](https://supercell.com/en/careers/why-you-might-love-it-here/): Overview of Supercell’s culture, values, and work environment.
- [Our Offices](https://supercell.com/en/careers/our-offices/): Information about Supercell office locations and teams.
- [Joining Supercell](https://supercell.com/en/careers/joining-supercell/): Hiring process guidance and what candidates can expect.
- [Career Stories](https://supercell.com/en/career-stories/): Employee stories and perspectives on working at Supercell.

## Living and Relocation
- [Living in Helsinki](https://supercell.com/en/careers/living-helsinki/): Practical information about living and working in Helsinki.
- [Living in London](https://supercell.com/en/careers/living-london/): Local guidance for candidates considering Supercell’s London office.
- [Living in Shanghai](https://supercell.com/en/careers/living-shanghai/): Local information for candidates interested in Shanghai opportunities.
- [Our Offices](https://supercell.com/en/careers/our-offices/): Office-specific context for relocation and workplace planning.
- [Joining Supercell](https://supercell.com/en/careers/joining-supercell/): Candidate guidance relevant to relocation and onboarding.

## Support and Player Help
- [Support](https://supercell.com/en/support/): Central support hub for player help and account issues.
- [Parent's Guide](https://supercell.com/en/parents/): Guidance for parents about Supercell games and player safety.
- [Be Safe & Play Fair](https://supercell.com/en/safe-fair-play/): Overview of safe play expectations and fair play principles.
- [Safe and Fair Play Policy](https://supercell.com/en/safe-and-fair-play/): Detailed policy covering player conduct and enforcement.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://supercell.com/en/accessibility-statement-supercell-com/): Accessibility information for Supercell.com and related commitments.

## Company
- [About Us](https://supercell.com/en/about-us/): Overview of Supercell’s mission, philosophy, and company background.
- [Media Center](https://supercell.com/en/media-center/): Press resources, media materials, and company assets.
- [Our Domains](https://supercell.com/en/our-domains/): Official list of Supercell-owned domains and web properties.
- [Supercell Home](https://supercell.com/): Main company homepage with links to games and company information.

## Legal and Policies
- [Terms of Service](https://supercell.com/en/terms-of-service/): Terms governing use of Supercell services and games.
- [Privacy Policy](https://supercell.com/en/privacy-policy/): Explanation of how Supercell collects and uses personal data.
- [Other Legal Docs](https://supercell.com/en/our-legal-documents/): Index of additional legal documents and policy materials.
- [Safe and Fair Play Policy](https://supercell.com/en/safe-and-fair-play/): Rules and enforcement policy for fair and safe gameplay.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://supercell.com/en/accessibility-statement-supercell-com/): Accessibility disclosures and website compliance information.

## Media and External Channels
- [Media Center](https://supercell.com/en/media-center/): Official media resources for journalists and partners.
- [Squad Busters](https://squadbusters.supercell.com/en/): Standalone game site with official game-specific content.
- [mo.co](https://mo.co): External official game site operated by Supercell.
- [Our Domains](https://supercell.com/en/our-domains/): Reference list for verifying official Supercell web properties.
